cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. We wanted somewhere to belong. This leaking cottage can still be ours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then we'll know every tile of the place we belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We hoped for a home, not an untouched savings account beside someone else's house.

mechanism: A coaches its former practical pupil to expand an early hope of belonging into doing and paying for the cottage repairs themselves.
confusable: Not generic optimism or guaranteed financial success: each setback becomes another way the same original hope can be fulfilled.
comparison: Private home and savings versus communal concert and shared lighting.
seedUse: D236 belonging/cottage/roof/savings/home; S05 home repair instruction.
